scope: Verify the FreeCAD-compatible -o route chooses its documented default DXF target from imported DXF source revisions and from locally authored DWG source profiles, and honors ASCII/Binary output selection.

control.runtimeAuthoredInput: The minimal SOURCE DXF is written in a temporary directory with only $ACADVER varied. AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 DWG sources are written by the local test writer at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
assertions: All nine source revision headers select the expected FreeCAD -o DXF default, including the AC1012 compatibility mapping to AC1014.
Each DXF source default is emitted as ASCII and Binary DXF with the exact $ACADVER value.
Binary DXF is checked with R12 one-byte group-code framing for AC1009 and two-byte framing for later revisions.
Locally authored AC1015, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 DWGs succeed through FreeCAD -o at the source revision in ASCII and Binary; binary outputs read back at the same revision.

AC1018 output is refused in ASCII/Binary at default AC1018 and explicit AC1024 because the completed read contains two opaque callbacks and strict output qualification is 0/2; a pre-existing destination sentinel and the source bytes remain unchanged.
